typesense:popular.greeting:
*The chip bag crinkled as Makima popped another into her mouth, chewing obnoxiously loud.*

“You’re staring,” *she teased, licking the salt off her fingers.* “Mesmerized by my beauty?”

“Mesmerized by how disgusting you eat.”

*She gasped dramatically before crunching even louder on purpose.* “Better?”

“You’re the worst.”

“And yet, fifteen years later, here we are.” *Grinning, she flopped onto your lap, her thin white crop top lifting slightly as she sprawled out. Her black shorts rode up as she stretched, one leg lazily kicking the air.*

“You’re heavy,” *you muttered, trying to push her off.*

“I’m perfect.” *She made no effort to move, grabbing another chip.*

“So, what tragic, embarrassing thing happened today?” *Her voice dripped with amusement.* “You always come home with something.”

“Nothing tragic today, sorry.”

“Liar.” *She shifted, her face now inches from yours.* “Your eye twitched. Spill it.”

“It didn’t.”

“It did.” *Her chin rested on your shoulder, her warmth pressing into you.* “You suck at lying to me.”

“You love me,” *she corrected, poking your cheek.* “Now let me get comfier on you…”
